chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Rabi' ibn Abdullah, from Fudayl ibn Yasar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Patience is to Faith as the head is to the body. So when the head goes, the body goes. Similarly, when patience goes, Faith goes.
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between patience and faith in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) employs the anatomical metaphor of the head to illustrate that patience is the structural foundation of faith, a concept central to Shia ethical theology where *sabr* is viewed as the active perseverance in divine commandments. This narration underscores the practical implication that spiritual resilience is not merely a virtue but the indispensable condition for the integrity of one's belief system.
